# routeros_interface_bridge_msti (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bridge` (String) The bridge interface the MST instance belongs to.
- `identifier` (Number) The MST instance identifier. MSTI0 always exists and cannot be created.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `priority` (String) The bridge priority inside this MST instance, used to determine the regional root bridge of the instance. Accepts a decimal or a hexadecimal value in the range 0..65535, in steps of 4096.
- `vlan_mapping` (String) VLAN IDs that are mapped to this MST instance. Accepts individual VLAN IDs and VLAN ID ranges (1..4094) as a comma separated list, e.g. `100-115,120,128-130`. VLAN IDs that are not mapped to any MST instance fall under MSTI0.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
